artworks.title: Sulisse Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a framed photograph of three people from the waist up. There is a woman on the left, a child in the middle, and a man on the right. The woman wears a patterned shawl and a white bonnet, with a neutral expression. The child wears a dark collared outfit and places one hand on the man's chest. The man wears a suit with a bow tie and has neatly combed dark hair. They are against a backdrop with an ornate foliage pattern, and the photograph is in a wooden frame against a dark matte background.

artworks.title: Writing Letter
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on the floor in a kneeling position. She is captured from the waist up. The woman has smooth facial features, dark hair styled neatly, and is dressed in a traditional striped kimono with an obi tied at the back. In her hands, she holds a piece of paper with calligraphy. Surrounding her are several wooden lacquered boxes of varying sizes. In the background, there is a decorative screen with painted fans and parts of a wooden cabinet. The setting is indoors, and the floor is covered with a woven mat.

artworks.title: Der Runde Turm und der Festung in Nürnberg (The Round Tower and Fortress in Nuremberg)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a cobblestone path leading towards a medieval tower and adjacent structures. The tower dominates the left side of the landscape, with a dark conical roof on top. To the right are a wall with arched passageways and pitched-roof buildings stretching into the distance. A person is seated on a stone wall next to the pathway. The scene is presented in sepia tones, adding an antique quality. Trees are scattered throughout the scene.

artworks.title: The Rescue of the Infant Oedipus
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Faith and Dewayne Perry, Austin, Texas
artworks.description: The image shows a dense woodland scene from a slightly elevated perspective. It captures the ground level and the towering heights of leafy trees. The horizon is not visible as the focus is on the foliage and tree trunks. The technique displays fine lines typical of engraving, detailing the texture of tree bark, leaves, and a human figure climbing a tree. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of gray for contrast and detail. In the background, hills or mountains are softly rendered under a textured sky with cloud formations.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Man Resting, Farm Houses, and a Castle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a figure seated on a rock surrounded by trees and foliage. The ground slopes into a valley, with a distant structure on the horizon. The trees are detailed with intricate lines, guiding the viewer's gaze. The color palette is sepia and brown, creating a timeless quality. The image balances detailed foreground elements with a softer background.

artworks.title: Trees
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and a building in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, allowing a view across a wooded area. The trees cast shadows on the ground, and there is a subtle slope in the terrain leading to the horizon. The building is partially hidden by trees. The image has a grainy, textured appearance, resembling early photographic processes with a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Il Duello (The Duel)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on wove paper [proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures sparring in an interior setting. The drawing captures a spacious room with high ceilings and wooden beams. On the left side, there are windows with intricately designed glass panels. Chairs are positioned along the wall. The floor is plain. Two figures are engaged in what appears to be a duel or sword practice. The contrast between light and shadow in the illustration emphasizes the depth and dimension of the space. The drawing has intricate and detailed line work, highlighting the architectural features and the posture of the figures.

artworks.title: Juno Seated on the Clouds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper, squared for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure surrounded by clouds. The drawing features a central figure on a soft, cloud-like surface. Around the central figure are dynamic, swirling lines representing ethereal clouds. The use of sepia tones and fluid linework conveys a sense of motion and otherworldliness.

artworks.title: Diana and Her Companions in a Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, looking down on a scene where a group of figures are gathered to the right side of the composition. The horizon line is low, with soft, diffuse boundaries between the sky and the earth. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, with a sketchy quality that suggests rather than defines forms. The color palette consists of muted browns and sepia tones, lending the scene a warm, monochromatic appearance. To the left, across an open space, a single figure in the distance gestures towards some trees. The figures and trees blend into the rocky landscape, wrapped in an atmosphere that feels serene and expansive.

artworks.title: Allegory of Peace
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a central figure seated on a block with an inscription that reads "PACE." The figure holds an olive branch in one hand and a chain in the other. A muscular figure lies bound beneath the central figure. Above them, a winged cherub-like figure crowns the seated figure with a garland. Two more winged figures, possibly putti, are present in the scene. The drawing is detailed with a focus on light and shadow, creating a sense of depth and classical elegance.

artworks.title: The Trojans Hauling the Wooden Horse into Troy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene depicting a large wooden horse surrounded by numerous soldiers. The image portrays an elaborate scene of an ancient military procession or event. The central focus is on the large wooden horse being pulled on wheels. The drawing is detailed, with soldiers and figures on horseback and foot engaged in various activities. The background features architectural elements such as arches and stone structures. The figures have exaggerated musculature and dynamic poses, conveying movement and intensity. Light and shadow enhance the three-dimensional form of the characters and objects. The composition is dense, with many human figures interacting and horses adding to the complexity and energy of the image.

artworks.title: The Farnese Hercules, front view [plate 2]
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular male figure standing in a relaxed pose against a textured background. The figure's right arm is bent at the elbow, resting on a large piece of fabric or a hide on a stone plinth. His left arm is bent behind his back. The figure has a strong jawline, a beard, and closely cropped curly hair. He is nude and displays a defined muscular structure. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects in the image. The setting has a classical and sculptural feel, with cross-hatching used for shading and texture.

artworks.title: The Farnese Hercules, three-quarter view turned to left  [plate 3]
artworks.description: The image shows a statue of a male figure standing on a pedestal. The statue is leaning slightly, with a bent left leg and the weight on the right leg. The head is bowed, with defined facial features, including a beard and curly hair. The torso is muscular, with the left arm hanging down and the right arm bent behind. The left arm holds the skin of an animal with visible head and paws. The figure is unclothed. Diagonal lines in the background add depth. Initials "PB" and the number "3" are in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: The Farnese Hercules, seen from behind [plate 4]
artworks.description: The image features a full body of a muscular figure standing upright with their back and side visible. The person is positioned with their weight on one leg and the opposite leg slightly bent at the knee. The person’s hair appears short and tightly curled, revealing the muscular definition of their neck and upper back. The person is unclothed, allowing for a detailed depiction of their musculature. Their hands are positioned behind the back, with fingers intertwined. Adjacent to the figure, there is a draped fabric or garment hanging, providing texture and contrast to the figure's skin. The background consists of a lined texture.

artworks.title: The Borghese Gladiator, front view [plate 26]
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular male figure in a dynamic pose. He is stepping forward with his right leg bent and left leg behind. His right arm is extended forward with a fist, while his left arm is slightly bent with a clenched fist. The man has pronounced facial features and a focused expression. He has short, curly hair and is depicted nude, emphasizing his musculature. He wears a band on his right forearm. The background is plain with textured surfaces and hatching lines that convey movement around the figure. The style resembles classic engraved or sketched art with attention to shading and muscle definition.

artworks.title: A Nude Fighting Man, side view, turned to left [plate 27]
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a muscular male figure in a dynamic, forward-leaning stance. His right arm is extended forward, and his left arm is bent back. The man's facial features are detailed with a pronounced jawline, and his hair is short and curly. The figure is nude, showcasing the musculature and anatomical form. Around him, the ground appears natural with foliage and a small rock in the foreground. In the background, there is a simple, lightly textured surface suggesting an outdoor setting without distinct elements such as buildings or landscapes, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: The Borghese Gladiator, side view, turned to right [plate 28]
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a male figure from the back. He is in a dynamic, athletic stance, leaning forward with his right arm extended and fist clenched. His left arm is bent and held close to his body. The man has short, curly hair and a muscular physique. He is nude except for a band on his right forearm. The background has a cross-hatched pattern, and the ground has sparse tufts of grass and rocks.

artworks.title: The Borghese Gladiator, back view [plate 29]
artworks.description: The image depicts the back view of a person posing with one leg forward, a raised arm bent at the elbow, and curly short hair. The person is unclothed, showing a muscular physique, with a ring on a finger of the raised hand. The background shows a natural setting with trees, bushes, and a textured sky, resembling a classical etching or illustration.

artworks.title: The Medici Wrestlers, side view, turned to right [plate 35]
artworks.description: This is an image of a wrestling match between two muscular figures. The figures are engaged in a physical struggle on a textured ground, with one positioned on top of the other. In the background, there are architectural elements, including large arches resembling ancient Roman architecture. The figures are depicted with detailed line work emphasizing their musculature and the intensity of their interaction.

artworks.title: The Medici Wrestlers, side view, turned to left [plate 36]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in wrestling. The drawing showcases two muscular figures entangled in an athletic struggle, with intricate detailing on their muscular forms and movement. The setting includes architectural elements resembling a column or the side of a structure, providing a classic backdrop. The composition includes foliage on the right side, suggesting an outdoor setting with trees and vegetation.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a jousting scene with armored horses and riders. The painting shows two armored figures, each on horseback, engaging in a jousting tournament. One horse and its rider are depicted in colorful armor, including a decorative flourish of flowers. The other figure has been unhorsed and is on the ground, covered in a green cloth that extends over the horse. The composition captures the moment of action and skill, with the energy of the horses and the intricacies of their armor depicted through delicate brushwork and a muted color palette. The style resembles medieval manuscript illustrations.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene. It features an armored rider on horseback with a long lance, engaged in a jousting match. The rider is leaning towards the ground, indicating motion of the lance as if striking a target. Another figure lies on the ground, seemingly dislodged from their horse. The horses are adorned in decorative caparisons with green and yellow patterns. The artwork portrays the movement and drama of a jousting scene, showcasing the elaborate armor and attire characteristic of medieval tournaments, offering insight into the pageantry and competitiveness of the era.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and corrected with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene with two armored horses and riders. One rider in a blue tunic has knocked the other rider off their striped brown and white horse. The fallen rider is on the ground beneath their horse, with a broken lance nearby. The victorious horse is adorned in blue, matching its rider. Both horses exhibit decorative detailing around the neck area. The composition captures a moment of impact and movement. The drawing style suggests a historical and heraldic quality, possibly indicative of illustrations from the medieval or Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Mixed Jousts of War and Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two armored figures jousting on horseback. The image depicts two horses, each ridden by an armored figure engaging in a joust. One horse is draped in a striped green and brown caparison while the other is in a plain dark color. The armored figures are each wielding a lance, with broken lance fragments visible in mid-air. The figures are outfitted in elaborate armor with helmets adorned with decorative crests. The painting is framed by a faint rectangular border.
